362674.rationale: TN-9 was redrawn (May 7, 2026) into a GOP seat; state Sen. Brent Taylor launched with Blackburn, Hagerty, and Scalise endorsements plus $1M self-funding. Rep. Todd Warner is the anti-establishment alternative. No Trump endorsement had been reported as of Jun 24.
362674.next_info: Trump Truth Social endorsement likely before early voting (Jul 17-Aug 1); primary Aug 6. Watch for any Warner-Trump contact.

716751.rationale: Megachurch pastor Adam Hamilton has raised >$2M, far ahead of the field, and leads an independent Change Research poll (Jun 11-15), though at only ~18% with 44-55% undecided. Schmidt's abuse-cover-up attack is disputed. This is an 11-way plurality race.
716751.next_info: Q2 FEC reports (Jul 15), any new public polls, and the Aug 4 primary results.

883794.rationale: El-Sayed leads most recent polls (Mitchell Jun 11-13: 42-33-6; Lake May: 34-31-19; Tulchin: 41-23-18), but TIPP had Stevens up 35-31. Stevens has $16M+ in AIPAC spending plus other super PAC money, and McMorrow's collapse may help Stevens. Older August turnout also favors Stevens.
883794.next_info: New polls in July, AIPAC/super PAC spending, and the Aug 4 primary.

874628.rationale: Two-way race: incumbent Ogles (beat a well-funded challenger 56.5-43.5 in 2024) vs. former Ag Commissioner Charlie Hatcher in a redrawn, more rural district that reaches into Memphis. The incumbency edge and likely Trump alignment favor Ogles.
874628.next_info: Trump endorsement status, any polls, Q2 FEC (Jul 15), and the Aug 6 primary.

49405.rationale: Special GOP primary under the reinstated 2023 map with no runoff (plurality wins). A Peak Insights poll (Jun 8-9) had state Rep. Rhett Marques at 30%, McKee 10%, and the rest at 4% or less.
49405.next_info: Trump/Britt endorsements, new polls, and the Aug 11 special primary.

720221.rationale: Mills is scandal-plagued (Ethics subcommittee probe, Mace expulsion resolution, $2M debt) but has Trump's endorsement, and the anti-Mills vote is split among Elijah (ex-FOX 35 anchor), Ulrich, and Johnson. Florida has no runoff.
720221.next_info: House Ethics ISC findings release (any time), possible withdrawal of Trump's endorsement, polls, and the Aug 18 primary.

845687.rationale: Only two Democrats qualified. Vindman raised $8.2M in Q1 and is the presumptive nominee in all general-election polling. State Rep. Angie Nixon had <$200K.

764491.rationale: In the Jun 16 special primary Wahab got ~42% to Hernandez's ~16% (both Democrats). The Aug 18 special general is D vs D, and Hernandez needs nearly all Republican and other votes to win.
764491.next_info: Endorsements by eliminated candidates and Republicans; mail voting starts Jul 20; election Aug 18.

720892.rationale: No report found as of Jun 24. The most plausible cases are general elections against anti-AIPAC Democrats: Michigan (Rogers vs. El-Sayed if he wins Aug 4; large Arab-American electorate) and Maine (Collins vs. Platner, who attacks her AIPAC money). This is speculative.

934953.next_info: New Trump Jr. foreign-deal revelations (summer), GOP senator statements, and September letters to Grassley.

Bloomberg (Jun 23) reported the White House is 'zeroing in' on Heidi Overton (deputy asst. to the president for domestic policy). Others vetted: Sharpless, Pops, Crowley (RBC list), Ferrara.

213487.next_info: Sentencing memos (late Jun/early Jul) and the Jul 8 11:15am hearing.

TN's 2025 executions proceeded without day-of stays, but the question wording hints a day-of stay is possible (a spiritual-advisor RLUIPA claim is the strongest hook).
138739.next_info: TN Supreme Court ruling on the protocol challenge; any federal RLUIPA suit; clemency petition to Gov. Lee (Sept); events on Sep 29-30.
